integrity: Theoretical analytical proof with finite independent numerical consistency checks; literature priority best-knowledge only, not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Finite Abelian connected undirected Cayley graphs; i.i.d. Haar coin average with unknown coin draws and both final registers retained; fixed graph and growing depth. The coherent-information single-letter theorem is established prior theory, not a novel lemma. No claim for quenched trajectories, correlated coins, variable graph dimension, non-Abelian groups, or rate per elementary step. Possible prior general entropy spectral asymptotics or equivalent capacity specializations remain priority risks.
title: Exact quantum-memory capacity and sharp spectral decay for Haar-coined Abelian walks
